Text: Human-in-the-Loop Escalation Design

Not every agent decision should be fully automated. High-risk or low-confidence cases need clean escalation paths to humans.

As a dev, I now design explicit escalation rules instead of relying on ad-hoc human checks.

Human-in-the-Loop Escalation Cheatsheet:
1. Define clear confidence and risk thresholds
2. Route low-confidence cases to the right human queue
3. Provide full context and recommended action
4. Set response time expectations
5. Log the human decision and feed it back
6. Gradually raise thresholds as the agent improves

Core principle: Escalation should be a designed feature, not an emergency workaround.

Pro tip: Make the escalation experience as smooth as the automated path — otherwise humans will avoid it.
